skills.name: synapse
skills.author: GhanibhutiGogoi
skills.description: Daily AI research × industry digest agent for OpenClaw. Cross-references new arXiv papers with AI industry news (HackerNews, Reddit, TechCrunch, VentureBeat, The Verge, MIT Tech Review), scores each paper for industry relevance, extracts structured summaries, and synthesizes buildable project ideas grounded in the bridge between research and current market signals. Runs once daily via OpenClaw cron at 9 AM and posts a 4-section markdown digest: Top Research, Industry Pulse, Research↔Industry Bridges, Buildable Opportunities. Five composing skills sharing one SQLite layer; no browser, no daemon.

skills.name: synapse-synth
skills.author: GhanibhutiGogoi
skills.description: Cross-references newly-ranked arXiv papers with AI industry news to compute industry-relevance scores and synthesize buildable project opportunities — concrete product ideas grounded in the bridge between new research and current market signals. The unique-value-add module of the Synapse agent. Two sub-tools: cross_ref (cosine similarity over TF token vectors → paper↔news links + a 0–2 industry-relevance score per paper) and opportunities (LLM-driven synthesis of {idea, rationale, paper_insight, market_signal} with a 5-rule quality rubric — must be buildable in <3 months, must use both the paper and the news, must be specific not vague, must not reinvent existing products).

skills.name: synapse-watchlist
skills.author: GhanibhutiGogoi
skills.description: Manages the configuration that drives every other Synapse skill: research keywords × arXiv categories to monitor, news sources (HackerNews, Reddit subreddits, RSS feeds), and the user's industry-focus preference (which biases opportunity synthesis toward chosen verticals). All operations write to a shared SQLite DB at data/arxiv.db; pure config management with no networking. Commands include seed-defaults (42 topics × 8 sources for AI/ML/DL/NN), add-topic, remove-topic, set-priority, add-source, remove-source, set-industry-focus, list-topics, list-sources, show-prefs.

skills.name: synapse-briefing
skills.author: GhanibhutiGogoi
skills.description: Entry-point skill of the Synapse agent. Orchestrates the daily pipeline (fetch papers → fetch news → rank both → cross-reference papers↔news → LLM summarize top 10 → LLM synthesize buildable opportunities) and renders a 4-section markdown digest: Top Research Today (table + top-3 expanded with structured summaries), Industry Pulse (top news grouped by source), Research↔Industry Bridges (paper-news cross-references with similarity scores), and Buildable Opportunities (concrete project ideas pairing paper insight with market signal). Also handles follow-up queries like "show me papers about graph neural networks from this week" and a status mode showing the last 7 daily runs. Triggers on "synapse briefing", "morning report", "daily digest", or the 9 AM cron.

skills.name: synapse-monitor
skills.author: GhanibhutiGogoi
skills.description: Daily arXiv ingestion and scoring pipeline. Three sub-tools: fetch_papers (queries the arXiv API once per (keyword × category) in the watchlist with polite 3 s delay, dedupes by arXiv ID, with a 4-day default window to handle arXiv's no-Sat/Sun announcement schedule), rank_papers (scores each paper 0–5 across keyword relevance + novelty regex + Semantic Scholar citation velocity with soft-fail), and summarize_papers (read/write helper for LLM-extracted {problem, method, contributions, results} summaries with explicit per-field quality rules — concrete problem statement, plain-language method, testable contributions, numeric results). The paper side of the daily Synapse pipeline; runs as stage 1 of /synapse-briefing.

skills.name: synapse-pulse
skills.author: GhanibhutiGogoi
skills.description: Aggregates AI industry news from heterogeneous sources via direct HTTP — no browser, no auth, no API keys. Three source kinds: HackerNews top stories (filtered to AI by keyword regex over titles), subreddit RSS (r/MachineLearning, r/LocalLLaMA, r/artificial), and any Atom/RSS feed (TechCrunch AI, VentureBeat AI, The Verge, MIT Tech Review). Each item gets a 0–3 score = AI-relevance (0–2, keyword TF over watchlist + AI vocabulary) + recency (0–1, full credit <24h, half <72h, zero past a week). Items below score 0.5 are treated as noise and don't propagate to the cross-referencing step. The news side of the daily Synapse pipeline; runs as stage 2 of /synapse-briefing.

Implementation uses networkx.
